sentences.en: An old worker was found repairing machinery in the workshop.
sentences.zh: 一位老工人在车间修理机器。

sentences.en: While we're sleeping the immune system opens its repair workshop.
sentences.zh: 当我们睡觉时，免疫系统开启了它的修复工场。

sentences.en: Yanni set up a workshop with cheap labor in Morocco.
sentences.zh: 杨尼在摩洛哥设立了廉价劳动力的工作室。
